## Mechanism

We will take the SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE3 keepers (defined as strategies passing initial filters in prior grinder stages) and:
1. Run OOS walk-forward analysis (using fixed IS/OOS splits) to ensure edge_capture stability across time.

3. Select the keeper with highest edge_capture that clears both gates.
